neighbours.label: the split pieces ' begr', ' thr' and ' гр' (a word opening on a consonant cluster)
fire: He gave the prize, begrudging every penny.
Nobody begrudges her the small win.
The band spent an hour thrashing out the song.
The horse kept thrashing in the mud.
Вода в реке стала грязной и мутной.
Руки у него всегда грязные после работы.
She paid him, begrudging the cost.
Waves were thrashing the old pier.
